title: ArrayTac: A Closed-Loop Piezoelectric Tactile Platform for Continuously Tunable Rendering of Shape, Stiffness, and Friction
abstract: arXiv:2603.13829v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Human touch depends on the integration of shape, stiffness, and friction, yet existing tactile displays cannot render these cues together as continuously tunable, high-fidelity signals for intuitive perception. We present ArrayTac, a closed-loop piezoelectric tactile platform that simultaneously renders these three tactile dimensions with continuous tunability on a 4 by 4 actuator array. Each unit integrates a three-stage micro-lever amplifier with end-effector Hall-effect feedback, enabling up to 5 mm displacement, an array refresh rate greater than 500 Hz, and a closed-loop bandwidth of 123 Hz. In psychophysical experiments, naive participants identified three-dimensional shapes and distinguished multiple stiffness and friction levels through touch alone without training. translated_title: ArrayTac：一个用于形状、刚度与摩擦力连续可调渲染的闭环压电触觉平台
translated_abstract: 人类的触觉依赖于形状、刚度和摩擦力三种线索的整合，然而现有的触觉显示器无法将这些线索作为连续可调、高保真的信号同时呈现，以支持直观感知。我们提出了ArrayTac，一个闭环压电触觉平台，可在4×4执行器阵列上同时渲染这三个触觉维度并实现连续可调。每个单元集成了三级微杠杆放大器和末端执行器霍尔效应反馈，可实现高达5毫米的位移、超过500 Hz的阵列刷新率以及123 Hz的闭环带宽。在心理物理学实验中，未经训练的普通参与者仅凭触觉即可识别三维形状，并区分多个刚度与摩擦力等级。我们进一步演示了从RGB图像到触觉的渲染，以及在超过一定距离（原文此处截断）上对医用级乳腺肿瘤仿真模型的远程触诊。
tldr: ArrayTac是一个闭环压电触觉平台，通过4×4执行器阵列连续可调地同时渲染形状、刚度和摩擦力三种触觉线索，使未经训练的用户仅凭触觉即可识别三维形状并区分刚度与摩擦等级，还支持图像到触觉的转换和远程触诊。
en_tdlr: ArrayTac is a closed-loop piezoelectric tactile platform that simultaneously renders shape, stiffness, and friction with continuous tunability on a 4×4 actuator array, enabling untrained users to identify 3D shapes and distinguish stiffness and friction levels through touch alone, while supporting image-to-touch rendering and remote palpation.
